message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-02 05:10 IST. High-confidence new relevant items were found for Elastic/Kibana, Ubuntu, and Google Chrome. A Fluentd item is included as a possible match needing review because fresh security coverage appeared today, but the primary GitHub advisories were published on 2026-06-26.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Elasticsearch and Kibana
- Issue: Multiple Elastic security advisories published 2026-07-01, including CVE-2026-56149, CVE-2026-49090, CVE-2026-49088, CVE-2026-49087, CVE-2026-56151, and CVE-2026-49089
- Severity: Medium, with CVSS scores ranging from 4.2 to 6.5 in the Elastic advisories reviewed.
- Why it matters: Elasticsearch and Kibana are both listed in Products.txt. Elastic published several July 1 advisories covering denial-of-service conditions, sensitive information in logs, and an AI Assistant authorization-bypass issue under specific authenticated or feature-enabled conditions.
- Source: Elastic ESA-2026-43 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-17-9-3-6-9-4-3-security-update-esa-2026-43/387440), ESA-2026-52 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-7-17-24-8-15-0-security-update-esa-2026-52/387447), ESA-2026-50 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-18-9-8-19-6-9-0-8-9-1-6-security-update-esa-2026-50/387445), ESA-2026-49 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-15-9-3-4-security-update-esa-2026-49/387444), ESA-2026-45 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-17-9-3-6-9-4-3-security-update-esa-2026-45/387442), and ESA-2026-51 (https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-16-3-8-17-2-security-update-esa-2026-51/387446).

**Finding 2**

- Product: Ubuntu
- Issue: Ubuntu Security Notices USN-8488-1, USN-8489-1, USN-8490-1, USN-8491-1, USN-8492-1, and USN-8493-1
- Severity: Not clearly stated on the Ubuntu notices page.
- Why it matters: Ubuntu is listed in Products.txt. Canonical published multiple July 1 Linux kernel and OEM kernel notices across Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, 25.10, and 26.04 LTS, covering large sets of CVEs fixed in supported Ubuntu kernel packages.
- Source: Ubuntu Security Notices (https://ubuntu.com/security/notices).

**Finding 3**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: Chrome 150 stable security update for desktop, including numerous CVEs such as CVE-2026-13774 through CVE-2026-13788 and related high-severity issues.
- Severity: Critical and High issues are listed by Google; the release includes 433 security fixes.
- Why it matters: Google Chrome is listed in Products.txt. Google promoted Chrome 150 to stable for Windows, Mac, and Linux and listed multiple Critical use-after-free, type-confusion, validation, and memory-safety issues. The advisory is dated 2026-06-30 and was surfaced in the current daily sweep; confirm local rollout timing if the previous digest already covered late-June browser updates.
- Source: Chrome Releases, Stable Channel Update for Desktop (https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/06/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0175352312.html).

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

- Product: Fluentd
- Issue: CVE-2026-44024, CVE-2026-44160, GHSA-72f5-rr8c-r6gr, and GHSA-pr7j-96cj-549h
- Severity: Critical for CVE-2026-44024; High for the SSRF, information-disclosure, and decompression DoS advisories.
- Why it needs review: Fluentd is listed in Products.txt and July 1 security coverage reported these as current Fluentd flaws. However, the primary GitHub Security Advisories reviewed were published on 2026-06-26, so they may have been captured in an earlier digest depending on the monitoring cadence.
- Source: GitHub Advisory GHSA-44hj-4m45-frj3 (https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/security/advisories/GHSA-44hj-4m45-frj3), GHSA-72f5-rr8c-r6gr (https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/security/advisories/GHSA-72f5-rr8c-r6gr), GHSA-pr7j-96cj-549h (https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/security/advisories/GHSA-pr7j-96cj-549h), and GHSA-j9cw-hwqf-85w7 (https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/security/advisories/GHSA-j9cw-hwqf-85w7).

- Product family: Cisco products
- Issue: Cisco July 1 advisories for Catalyst Center, Secure Endpoint, and ClamAV-affected Cisco products
- Severity: Some public summaries report CVSS 7.5 for the July 1 Cisco Catalyst Center and ClamAV-related advisories.
- Why it needs review: The monitored Cisco entries are Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender. The accessible source summaries did not confirm that the July 1 Cisco advisories affect those specific monitored products, so these were not promoted to confirmed findings.
- Source: Cisco advisory listing and publication notice (https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-notice-vwL7b0S7).

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for Chrome desktop update posture because Google lists Critical issues, and for any Elastic/Kibana deployments using the affected features or versions. Ubuntu kernel updates should be reviewed according to the supported releases in use. Fluentd should be checked if the June 26 advisories were not already handled in a prior run.
